cards.card_text: Then Jesus goes on about a stone's throw beyond them, kneels down and prays, "Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me." Friend, that's the Son of God on His knees, talking to His Father.
cards.verse_text: And He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, where He knelt down and prayed, “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”
